items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-11-17
items.q: Black Benny was about the best guy in there. You know, bass drum... But we picked him up before he got killed, put him on Snag.

ctx.x: Eddie Woods. Eddie Woods? Eddie Woods is Faso's name.

Eddie Woods is Faso's name. Eddie Woods, that's his name? Right name, Faso's name? Oh, yeah. You didn't ever say nothing about Snag, Cliff Jones. Yeah, and who did you say? Cliff Jones called him Snag. You remember, Cliff? Oh, yeah. And I'll tell you another, Black Benny was about the best guy in there. You know, bass drum. Bass drum, yeah. Bass drum. You know, in a parade, bass band. But we picked him up before he got killed, put him on Snag. He was good then. But I said he got killed. Yeah, I was really pretty…
Ask him if he followed parades. You hear myself?

items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1960-01-21
items.q: And when Bobby left, we got Black Benny.

ctx.x: What band was that? Let me see my band. Oh, that was a little bit of a band. Bobby used to play. And we had facial for it. And with facial and that, we got Bobby. And when Bobby left, we got Black Benny. And that's where Black Benny said he was going to make a man out of himself. And Black Benny stuck with it, so they got killed. And a little while after that, that's where the band broke up. Maurice come in, you know, from the war. Chris Johnson had taken all the Cornette players. We had to keep on changing…
Ask me about bazooka players. Bazooka? Yeah, you know, like those big horns made out of two pieces of pipe.

items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-11
items.q: I'm thinking about Black Benny. Yeah.

ctx.x: Oh, you mean, oh. Black Happy.

Well, that was Black Happy. Uh-huh. No, I'm thinking about Black Benny. Yeah. I'm thinking about Black Benny. Why don't y'all want to straighten out on this? I'm thinking about Black Benny, man. Yeah.
Well, uh. Ask him who was with Poe Ree's band. Poe Ree's? Poe Ree.
